summary: No record change this turn. I re-checked the knowledge entry that several accounts depend on against the source, and util.go confirms it exactly: the local-message set is the nine types already recorded (MsgHup, MsgBeat, MsgUnreachable, MsgSnapStatus, MsgCheckQuorum, MsgStorageAppend, MsgStorageAppendResp, MsgStorageApply, MsgStorageApplyResp) with MsgForgetLeader absent from it, so no correction was needed. I also started filing an experiment so the window-and-quorum child question has a receipt at its own level, reusing the existing harness, but the request text was cut short before submission, so nothing was filed and the draft stays valid. The child question's answer already exists inside the main account and in a sibling child; what is missing is only its own-level receipt. Otherwise the account is unchanged and coherent: one finding asserted with seven receipts including a reproduction, six child questions answered, severity bounded by measured aftermath and self-step-down observations, and the remaining limits scope-only.
